body.heading: Insertion of new section 38A in the principal enactment
body.raw_text: The following new section is hereby inserted immediately after section 38 of the principal enactment and shall have effect as section 38A:-
body.text: The following new section is hereby inserted immediately after section 38 of the principal enactment and shall have effect as section 38A:-

children.heading: Notary to explain the true nature of the transaction

children.raw_text: It shall be the duty of every notary-
children.text: It shall be the duty of every notary-

children.raw_text: to endeavour to ascertain the true legal nature of the transaction between the parties and execute the deed or instrument for the true transaction; and
children.text: to endeavour to ascertain the true legal nature of the transaction between the parties and execute the deed or instrument for the true transaction; and

children.raw_text: specifically, and expressly explain to the executants the true nature of every deed or instrument before any executant signs such deed or instrument.
children.text: specifically, and expressly explain to the executants the true nature of every deed or instrument before any executant signs such deed or instrument.

children.raw_text: He shall not directly or indirectly authenticate or attest any deed of transfer in respect of a transaction, which is in fact a mortgage, a conditional transfer, or any other similar instrument or deed.
children.text: He shall not directly or indirectly authenticate or attest any deed of transfer in respect of a transaction, which is in fact a mortgage, a conditional transfer, or any other similar instrument or deed.

children.raw_text: Any notary who shall knowingly and willfully execute a deed or instrument in violation of subsection (1) or (2) above shall be guilty of an offence, and be liable to a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand rupees.
children.text: Any notary who shall knowingly and willfully execute a deed or instrument in violation of subsection (1) or (2) above shall be guilty of an offence, and be liable to a fine not exceeding five hundred thousand rupees.

body.heading: Avoidance of doubt
body.raw_text: For the avoidance of doubt, it is hereby declared that the provisions of this Act shall not affect any deed or instrument lawfully executed prior to the date of commencement of this Act and pending registration in accordance with the provisions of the Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117).

body.raw_text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
